item.title: Morocco Allocates $330 Million For Flood-Hit Northern Regions
item.description: Morocco is spending $330 million to aid northern provinces hit by floods, repairing infrastructure, supporting farmers, and assisting displaced residents.

item.title: Femi Adegolu: Bitcoin Is Digital Gold, Has Outperformed Other Assets
item.description: Femi Adegolu, Co-Founder, TradePal AI, says Bitcoin is digital gold, and has outperformed most traditional assets over time.

item.title: Tinubu To Visit Kebbi, Inaugurate Projects, Attend Argungu Festival
item.description: President Tinubu heads to Kebbi Saturday to inaugurate projects and attend Argungu International Fishing Festival.

item.title: Elumelu Praises Tinubu’s Reforms, Warns Power Gap Threatens Growth
item.description: Elumelu lauds forex stability and MSME support but says electricity crisis remains Nigeria’s biggest economic bottleneck.

item.title: Tinubu: Ethical Leadership, Strong Institutions Surest Path To Peace, Development
item.description: President Tinubu says ethical leadership and strong institutions remain the surest path to peace, justice and sustainable development.

item.description: Activist Deji Adeyanju insists El-Rufai must face investigation, says due process is not persecution.

item.description: Former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai alleges that security agencies are being deployed for political ends against opposition figures.

item.title: Nigeria Redeploys VIP Police To Vulnerable North-Central Communities
item.description: Nigeria's federal government has reassigned VIP-duty police officers to Kwara and North-Central communities under expanded security operations.

item.title: Report Warns Nigeria, 35 African Countries Face Fiscal Crunch
item.description: A report by McKinsey says Nigeria and 35 African nations face tightening fiscal space as weak revenues widen deficits.
